query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as "count!"
           FROM v2_job_completed c
           JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = c.id
           WHERE j.workspace_id = $1
             AND j.kind IN ('dependencies', 'flowdependencies', 'appdependencies')
             AND c.status IN ('failure', 'canceled')
             AND j.created_at >= (
                 SELECT pc.started_at
                 FROM git_sync_synced_head h
                 JOIN v2_job_completed pc ON pc.id = h.job_id
                 WHERE h.workspace_id = $1 AND h.branch = $3 AND h.sha = $2
                   AND h.source = 'pull'
             )
